title: lava db:migrate --json
description: Applies every pending migration as one batch. `applied` is what this run actually recorded — which on a FAILED run is the migrations that succeeded before the failure, not an empty list. The database has changed by then, and an agent must not be told otherwise.

applied.description: Names of the migrations applied and recorded by this run, in the order they ran. Empty when there was nothing pending.

batch.description: The batch those migrations went into, which is the argument `db:rollback --batches` will need. 0 when this run applied nothing, including the case where it failed on its first migration.
